about: Which VPS runners may check a signed release draft: release.yml's verify job asks for this label beside thornswood-vps, so it runs on these runners and no other (#3956). None of them is in records/sign-runners.json, so the runner that checks is never the one that signed and holds no signing client (#2163); tests/test-release-workflow.ps1 holds that. Runner 4 is a light runner: it is in no other record, and no heavy job asks for a label it carries, so a pull request build can never hold it and the check starts within seconds of the draft. Runners 1 and 2 carry the label too, so the check also takes a build runner that is free first, and still runs while runner 4 is not installed. GitHub's runner labels follow this file on main: a push that changes it runs github-admin.yml, and pwsh scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 asks again (#3107). scripts/deploy/Install-Runner.ps1 registers a runner listed here with the label too, so a reinstall keeps it. Measured 26 Oct 2026 (#3956): v1.2.7's draft was made at 7:15 PM MDT and its check, then on thornswood-build, started at 8:03 PM, while six pull request builds held or waited for runners 1 and 2.
label: thornswood-check
